suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update cleanup-worker SKILL.md collapsible_if guidance: for edition 2024+ codebases, use let chain syntax (e.g., if let Some(x) = a && let Some(y) = b) instead of merging nested if conditions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-clippy-collapsible-if review: SKILL.md says 'merge nested if conditions' but edition 2024 requires let chain syntax, which is a distinct pattern. Worker noted the feature description underestimated error counts (49 vs 80+ actual).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to cleanup-worker SKILL.md: For bulk clippy fixes, consider using 'cargo clippy --fix --workspace --allow-dirty --allow-staged' followed by 'cargo fmt' to auto-fix remaining issues after manual edits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-clippy-collapsible-if transcript: worker used cargo clippy --fix to resolve 17 remaining errors after manual edits, followed by cargo fmt. This is a useful technique for bulk fixes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance that clippy-fixing features should run cargo clippy first to get exact error counts and file lists before writing the feature description.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-clippy-collapsible-if: feature description said 49 errors but there were 80+. Additional errors were in katla_app which the feature description didn't fully cover.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to coding conventions: When upgrading Rust edition, always run cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings after edition changes. The 2024 edition enables let_chains which makes clippy enforce collapsible_if on nested if-let statements.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: foundation-edition-upgrade upgraded to edition 2024 but did not collapse nested if-let chains in katla_ecs query iterators or katla_ui, causing 49+ clippy errors (carried forward from round 1).
